stories.title: Sealed displacement, session chips, and Esc two-tier in ParsedInput
stories.description: As a user, I want a newly typed token to overwrite the same-kind chip to its left — without ever losing text to half-typed words — so that correcting metadata is one gesture.
acceptanceCriteria: While a displacing token is unsealed (not followed by whitespace and field not submitted), the displaced range renders demoted (plain text); nothing is deleted from value
Typing 'satchel' character-by-character into a field with an existing date chip never removes that chip's text; the chip re-activates when 'sat' stops being the parse

When the displacing token seals (space typed after it, or submit), the displaced range is removed from value via onChange; the seam collapses to a single space; trailing/leading trim happens only in the extracted title, never in the live field
Caret rule: removals left of the caret shift the caret offset down by the removed length (visually stationary); removals right of the caret leave it untouched
Fixpoint: immediately after a displacement removal, re-parse with the same reverted ranges yields displaced: [] (asserted in component tests)

Session chip defined as: a chip whose (kind, parsed value) pair is absent from the baseline ParseResult of the mount-time value with initialReverts. Esc with >=1 session chip reverts the most recent one; Esc with none calls onCancel
In CommandBar (no onCancel change): Esc behavior for chips is unchanged from the user's perspective; submit on Enter removes any unsealed-displaced ranges before capture

Component tests in src/components/ParsedInput.test.tsx cover: seal-on-space, seal-on-submit, transient prefix (satchel), caret offset both sides, fixpoint, session-chip discrimination (in-place friday->monday is revertible; untouched baseline chip is not)

Same-wave stories own disjoint files: views live in src/views/<View>.tsx, components in src/components/, App.tsx is owned by exactly one in-flight story at a time
Date helpers use ISO weekday numbering 1=Mon..7=Sun; all date math via local components (new Date(y,m-1,d+n,12))

Parser: pass order recurrence->date->time->list->priority, LAST-wins per kind with displaced ranges (chip+displaced ranges excluded from title; reverted ranges unmatchable), word-level whole-token matching; chip displays: date "Wed Jun 10" (+year when != now year), time "3:00 PM", list "#work", priority "P1", recurrence source text
Store: reducer(state, action) pure; mutating payloads carry injected ids/dates (newId, completedAt, today); internal inverse action types restore/markDone/revertComplete
UI: classes shell-column/masthead/view-tabs/view-tab/keycap/empty-state in App.css; tokens only; aria-current=page marks active tab; useApp() from src/state/AppContext
Component tests: // @vitest-environment jsdom pragma + src/test-setup.ts localStorage shim; probe context state by rendering a JSON <pre> probe inside AppProvider
TaskList sections prop: [{label, tasks, rollover?}]; empty sections omitted; all-empty renders empty-state line. TaskRow classes: task-row--p1/--rollover/--selected/--done
Toast: useApp().toast + showToast; wrapped dispatch emits Captured/Completed/Done — next <date>/Deleted/Snoozed to <date>/Scheduled/Saved/Reopened/Undone/Redone
useKeymap config: callbacks (onComplete/onEdit/onDelete/onSnooze/onUndo/onRedo/onTypeahead) + getRowIds reads DOM .task-row[data-task-id]; today injectable
DST-sensitive unit tests pin process.env.TZ=America/New_York as first line of the test file; midnight math via new Date(y,m,d+1,0,0,0) local constructor, never +24h
New components get their own CSS file next to the component (StorageBanner.css pattern), tokens only

token_precedence.value: pass order recurrence->date->time->list->priority; LAST-wins per kind (supersedes first-wins / old FR-9); earlier same-kind token ranges reported in ParseResult.displaced; chip AND displaced ranges are both excluded from title; tokens inside reverted ranges match nothing

sealing.value: displaced text is removed from the field only when the displacing token is sealed (followed by whitespace, or on submit); until sealed it renders demoted; seam collapses to a single space; live field is never trimmed

serializer_token_order.value: title, date, time, recurrence, list, priority

date_serialization.value: yesterday/today/tomorrow at now-1/now/now+1; '<mon> <day>' within next 12 months; '<mon> <day> <year>' otherwise; chip display shows year when date year != now year

esc_two_tier.value: Esc reverts the most recent session chip ((kind, parsed value) absent from mount-time baseline parse); with no session chips Esc invokes onCancel (edit: cancel; bar: existing behavior)

chip_class.notes: class name intentionally unchanged when chip CSS moves to ParsedInput.css in US-104, keeping the visual baseline stable
